review.notes: Tool-form continue_work. PASS-candidate requires dispatch accepted + observable scheduled tool result + wake event. Detector must ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt echoes; do not require an event name that the seat does not emit.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continue_work schedule + wake row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for repeatability. Serialize per session (sameSessionConcurrencySafe=false). Ignore harness prompt echo; PASS requires explicit CW-SCHEDULED and CW-WOKE sentinels; the scenario embeds the CW-WOKE instruction in the continue_work reason so the wake turn has the required sentinel instruction.
